page: Google Cloud Platform a4x-maxgpu-4g-metal is an accelerator-optimized bare-metal server designed for intensive computational workloads. It features 144 dedicated vCPUs based on the arm64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 960.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.67 GB of RAM per core.

The server is configured with four NVIDIA Blackwell GB300 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 1116 GB of VRAM. This massive graphics memory pool is engineered to support large-scale parallel processing tasks. Local storage is listed as none, meaning external block storage must be provisioned for persistent data.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this bare-metal instance represents a high-density hardware class tailored for workloads where GPU-to-CPU and GPU-to-memory ratios must be maximized. It is designed for workloads such as large language model training, complex data science jobs, high-performance computing, and intensive machine learning inference.
